instruction: I am throwing a party for all of my friends and roommates upcoming Saturday night. I need return gifts for them. Buy backpacks on amazon with at least 4.5 rating, and with 6 or more reviews, one for each invitee, and make sure they reach home by the end of the day before the party.
notes: Fix: the predicate formerly named home-address clashed with the object home-address; the predicate is now is-home-address. Current date is Thursday 2023-05-25, so the party is Saturday 2023-05-27 and all backpacks must be delivered by end of Friday 2023-05-26. Invitees = union of phone contacts with relationship 'friends' and 'roommates'; these two relationship values are domain constants so add-to-cart can require both searches without quantified preconditions, and the runtime quantity qty-invitees is the unique-contact count. Product selection: search_products filters by product_type=backpack and min_product_rating=4.5; show_product is the verification step where the agent checks num_product_reviews >= 6 and the delivery estimate against the deadline (numeric checks are left to the binding rule). add_product_to_cart uses clear_cart_first=true so the order contains only the chosen product with the invitee quantity. place_order must use the home address from amazon.show_addresses (no address updates/deletes) and any card from show_payment_cards. supervisor.complete_task carries the ordered record parameters only for goal checking (no answer is submitted). Pagination of search results is not modeled.
